en-US.description: Ask Alexa what's for lunch at Woodmen Roberts Elementary School in Academy District 20 (ASD20). Get today's or tomorrow's school lunch menu instantly. Just say 'Alexa, ask Woodman Roberts what's for lunch today' and hear the menu options. Data is fetched from the school's public Nutrislice menu system.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Woodman Roberts what's for lunch today
Alexa, ask Woodman Roberts what's for lunch tomorrow
en-US.name: Woodman Roberts School Lunch
en-US.summary: Check the daily lunch menu at Woodmen Roberts Elementary in Academy District 20
